sn46.28:1.8: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn46.28:1.9: kathaṃ bhāvitā nu kho bhante, satta bojjhaṅgā kathaṃ bahulīkatā nibbedhāya saṃvattantīti.
sn46.28:2.1: idhūdāyi, bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ vipulaṃ mahaggataṃ appamāṇaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ.
sn46.28:2.2: so satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāvitena cittena anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ lobhakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati, padāleti.
sn46.28:2.5: upekhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ vipulaṃ mahaggataṃ appamāṇaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ.
sn46.28:2.6: so upekhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāvitena cittena anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ lobhakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti.
sn46.28:2.9: evaṃ bhāvitā kho udāyi, satta bojjhaṅgā evaṃ bahulīkatā nibbedhāya saṃvattantīti.
